description:
A powerful clipboard manager for Windows

ClipMate is a modern clipboard manager that helps you manage your clipboard history,
organize clips into collections, and boost your productivity with powerful features
like PowerPaste, Quick Paste, and advanced text manipulation tools.
ClipMate 1.0.1-beta

Installation
WinGet:
winget install Tsabo.ClipMate
Installer (Recommended):
- Target OS: Windows 11 or Windows 10 version 1809+
- Auto-installs if needed: .NET 10 Desktop Runtime, ASP.NET Core 10 Runtime, WebView2 Runtime
- Simply download and run - dependencies handled automatically
Portable:
- Extract ZIP and run ClipMate.exe
- Requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime and ASP.NET Core 10 Runtime pre-installed
- Requires WebView2 Runtime (usually pre-installed on Windows 11)
Security
✅ Code Signed - The installer, uninstaller and ClipMate binaries are signed by Jeremy Brown (Certum)
Verification
SHA-256 Checksums:
# Verify installer
(Get-FileHash ClipMate-Setup-1.0.1-beta.exe).Hash -eq (Get-Content ClipMate-Setup-1.0.1-beta.exe.sha256).Split()[0]
# Verify portable
(Get-FileHash ClipMate-Portable-1.0.1-beta.zip).Hash -eq (Get-Content ClipMate-Portable-1.0.1-beta.zip.sha256).Split()[0]
